name: LNbits
description: LNbits is a free and open-source Bitcoin Lightning wallet and accounts system. It provides isolated wallets, API keys, LNURL tools, extensions, merchant workflows, and admin controls on top of a configurable Lightning funding source.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent LNbits data, SQLite database, logs, super user state, backups, and installed extensions.

paths.name: Config File
paths.description: Optional .env file based on the upstream .env.example. Leave blank to configure with the variables in this template and the Admin UI.

paths.name: LND Data
paths.description: Optional read-only mount for an LND data directory. Useful when using LndWallet or LndRestWallet with cert and macaroon paths under /lnd.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: LNbits web interface and API port. Container port: 5000.

variables.name: Data Folder
variables.description: LNbits data folder inside the container. Keep this pointed at the Data mount.

variables.name: Extensions Path
variables.description: Persistent path for installed LNbits extensions. Without this, installed extensions can be lost when the container is recreated.

variables.name: Admin UI
variables.description: Enable the LNbits Admin UI and first-install super user flow. Use true or false.

variables.name: HTTPS Only Auth Cookies
variables.description: Set true when LNbits is served only over HTTPS. Leave false for direct local HTTP access through the Unraid Web UI.

variables.name: Backend Wallet Class
variables.description: Lightning funding source class. Start with VoidWallet for testing, then use PhoenixdWallet, LndRestWallet, LndWallet, CoreLightningWallet, or another supported backend.

variables.name: Default Extensions
variables.description: Comma-separated extensions installed by default on restart. Remove an extension from this list before uninstalling it permanently.

variables.name: Public Base URL
variables.description: Optional public URL used behind a reverse proxy, for example https://lnbits.example.com/.

variables.name: Site Title
variables.description: Browser and UI title for this LNbits instance.

variables.name: Auth Secret Key
variables.description: Recommended strong random secret for auth signing. Set this before production use.

variables.name: First Install Token
variables.description: Optional token required on the first-install page.

variables.name: Allowed Auth Methods
variables.description: Comma-separated auth methods, for example user-id-only, username-password, nostr-auth-nip98, google-auth, github-auth, keycloak-auth, or oidc-auth.

variables.name: Debug
variables.description: Enable verbose debug mode. Use True or False.

variables.name: Forwarded Allow IPs
variables.description: Trusted proxy IPs for forwarded headers. Use * when LNbits is behind a trusted local reverse proxy.

variables.name: Postgres Database URL
variables.description: Optional external database URL. Leave blank to use SQLite in the Data path.

variables.name: Phoenixd API Endpoint
variables.description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is PhoenixdWallet. Use the reachable Phoenixd HTTP API URL, for example http://UNRAID-IP:9740/ or http://phoenixd:9740/ on a custom Docker network.

variables.name: Phoenixd API Password
variables.description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is PhoenixdWallet. Use the Phoenixd full-access API password from phoenix.conf.

variables.name: LND REST Endpoint
variables.description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is LndRestWallet. Use the reachable LND REST URL, for example https://UNRAID-IP:8081/ or https://lnd:8080/ on a custom Docker network.

variables.name: LND REST Cert
variables.description: LND TLS certificate path inside the LNbits container, or the certificate content accepted by LNbits.

variables.name: LND REST Macaroon
variables.description: LND admin macaroon path inside the LNbits container, or hex/base64 macaroon content.

variables.name: LND gRPC Endpoint
variables.description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is LndWallet. Hostname or IP of the LND gRPC endpoint.

variables.name: LND gRPC Port
variables.description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is LndWallet. LND gRPC port.

variables.name: LND gRPC Cert
variables.description: LND TLS certificate path inside the LNbits container, or the certificate content accepted by LNbits.

variables.name: LND gRPC Macaroon
variables.description: LND admin macaroon path inside the LNbits container, or hex/base64 macaroon content.
